info.story1: I swapped my old iPhone for a guitar I always wanted. Found the match in 2 days!
info.story2: We exchanged apartments for summer vacation. Saved thousands on hotel costs.
info.story3: Traded my web development skills for professional photography lessons. Win-win!
info.costCalculatorDesc: See how much you save by swapping instead of buying
info.teamDesc: The people and technology behind Swaply
info.faqA1: List your items, browse others' items, and propose swaps. AI helps match compatible items based on category, value, and preferences.
info.faqA2: Yes! The basic plan is free with unlimited swaps. Premium tiers offer additional features like priority matching, map pins, and more tokens.
info.faqA3: All messages are moderated, public meeting spots are recommended, and both parties must confirm each step of the exchange process.
info.faqQ4: What if the other person doesn't show up?
info.faqA4: You can cancel the swap at any stage. Reputation scores reflect reliability, so unreliable users get lower match priority.
info.faqA5: Our scoring algorithm considers 9 factors: category match, intent compatibility, flexibility, perceived value, location, bundle acceptance, subcategory, tag overlap, and sentimental value.
info.howStep1Desc: Add photos, description, and what you'd like in exchange
info.howStep2Desc: AI analyzes compatibility and suggests the best swaps
info.howStep3Desc: Discuss details in secure moderated chat
info.howStep4Desc: Meet locally, ship by courier, or pick up — with full tracking
info.sustainabilityDescription: Every swap saves resources and reduces waste
info.sustainabilityNote: Estimates based on average product lifecycle analysis. Each reused object avoids ~4.2 kg CO₂ from manufacturing.
info.leaderboardDescription: Most active community members this month
info.leaderboardNote: Leaderboard resets monthly. Activity includes completed swaps, positive ratings, and consistent engagement.
info.badgeBenefitsDescription: Premium and Platinum benefits: priority in analysis, map pins, completeness indicator, and more.
info.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know before you start.
info.guideStep1Text: Takes 2 minutes. You only need an email. No card required.
info.guideStep2Title: Add what you want to swap
info.guideStep2Text: Take 3-5 good photos, write an honest description, say what you'd like in return. Items with photos get 4x more proposals.
info.guideStep3Title: Browse or let the match do the work
info.guideStep3Text: Browse manually or enable auto-match which finds people who have what you want and want what you have.
info.guideStep4Text: Send a request with your item and what you want in return. The other person accepts, declines, or counter-proposes.
info.guideStep5Text: Work out the details via chat: meet face to face or use a courier. Confirm the swap and leave a rating.
info.earlyStageTitle: We're just getting started. Be among the first.
info.earlyStageText: The Swaply community is growing every day. Add your first items and be a pioneer of direct swapping.
info.metaDescription: Learn how Swaply works: post objects, get AI matches, chat and swap. Free platform for object exchange.

legal.termsEligibilityText: You must be at least 16 years old to use Swaply. Minors between 16-18 require parental consent. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
legal.termsAccountRulesText: One account per person. Provide accurate information. Do not share credentials. You may delete your account at any time from Profile > Account & Settings.
legal.termsSwapRulesText: Swaply facilitates object exchanges between users. All swaps are voluntary agreements between participants. Swaply is not a party to any swap and bears no liability for the condition of exchanged items. Both parties must confirm each step of the exchange process.
legal.termsProhibitedText: Illegal items, weapons, drugs, counterfeit goods, stolen property, and hazardous materials are strictly prohibited. Swaply reserves the right to remove any listing that violates these rules and to suspend the associated account.
legal.termsModerationText: All messages are automatically moderated for profanity, personal data leaks, and spam. AI-based content analysis is used for item classification. Users may report inappropriate content or behavior.
legal.termsLiabilityText: Swaply is provided "as is" without warranties. We are not liable for any damages resulting from swaps, including but not limited to item quality, shipping issues, or no-shows. Users are encouraged to meet in public places and use tracked shipping.
legal.termsChangesText: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance. Major changes will be communicated via notification.
legal.termsContactText: For questions about these terms, contact us at support@swaply.app.
legal.privacyDataCollectedText: We collect: email address, display name, location (city level), item listings, messages, swap history, and usage analytics. We do NOT collect exact GPS coordinates unless explicitly enabled by the user.
legal.privacyPurposeText: Your data is used to: provide the swap matching service, moderate content for safety, send notifications about your swaps, and improve the platform experience. We do not sell your data to third parties.
legal.privacyLegalBasisText: Processing is based on: your consent (account creation, cookie acceptance), contract performance (swap facilitation), and legitimate interest (platform security, fraud prevention).
legal.privacySharingText: We share data with: Supabase (database hosting, EU region), Cloudinary (image hosting), HuggingFace (AI content analysis, server-side only). Your profile information is visible to other users based on your visibility settings.
legal.privacyCookiesText: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. Optional analytics cookies help us understand usage patterns. You can manage cookie preferences at any time via the cookie consent banner.
legal.privacyRightsText: You have the right to: access your data (available in your profile), correct inaccurate data, delete your account and all associated data, export your data, withdraw consent, and lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.
legal.privacyRetentionText: Account data is retained while your account is active. Upon deletion, all personal data is removed within 30 days. Anonymized swap statistics may be retained for platform analytics.
legal.privacyContactText: Data controller: Swaply. For GDPR requests, contact privacy@swaply.app. DPO contact: dpo@swaply.app.
legal.cookieBannerText: We use essential cookies for authentication and optional analytics cookies to improve the platform. No advertising cookies are used.
legal.cookiesWhatText: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and improve your experience. Swaply uses cookies to keep you logged in and to understand how the platform is used.
legal.cookiesEssentialText: These cookies are required for the platform to function. They handle authentication (keeping you logged in), session management, language preferences, and CSRF protection. Without these cookies, Swaply cannot operate properly. They cannot be disabled.
legal.cookiesAnalyticsText: Optional analytics cookies help us understand usage patterns: which pages are visited most, how users navigate, and where they encounter issues. This data is aggregated and anonymized. Analytics cookies are only set if you accept them via the cookie consent banner.
legal.cookiesThirdPartyText: Swaply uses Supabase for authentication, which may set its own cookies for session management. We do not use advertising cookies or share cookie data with ad networks. No tracking pixels or social media cookies are present on the platform.
legal.cookiesManageText: You can manage your cookie preferences using the consent banner that appears on your first visit. To change your choice later, clear your browser's localStorage for this site. You can also disable cookies in your browser settings: Chrome (Settings > Privacy > Cookies), Firefox (Settings > Privacy > Cookies), Safari (Preferences > Privacy). Note: disabling essential cookies will prevent login.
legal.cookiesContactText: For questions about our cookie policy, contact us at privacy@swaply.app.
legal.safetyGeneralText: Trust your instincts. If a deal feels too good to be true, it probably is. Always communicate through the Swaply chat — our messages are moderated for your safety. Never share personal information (phone number, address, bank details) until you are confident in the other party. Check the user's profile, rating, and completed swaps before agreeing to an exchange.
legal.safetyMeetingText: Always meet in a public, well-lit place (cafés, shopping centers, police station lobbies). Bring a friend if possible. Meet during daylight hours. Tell someone you trust where you are going and when. Inspect the item carefully before confirming the swap. Use the in-app QR confirmation to finalize the exchange.
legal.safetyShippingText: Use tracked shipping services only. Take photos of the item and packaging before sending. Keep shipping receipts and tracking numbers. Do not mark a swap as complete until you have received and inspected the item. If using courier services, ensure both parties agree on who pays shipping costs before sending.
legal.safetyScamsText: Be wary of users who: pressure you to complete swaps quickly, ask to communicate outside Swaply, offer items of unusually high value for common items, refuse to meet in person or use tracked shipping, ask for money or gift cards as part of the swap. Report suspicious behavior immediately using the report button on the user's profile.
legal.safetyReportingText: Use the Report button on any user profile or item listing to flag suspicious content. Our moderation team reviews all reports within 24 hours. You can also block users to prevent further contact. For urgent safety concerns, contact your local authorities first, then notify us at safety@swaply.app.
legal.safetyContactText: For safety questions or to report an incident, contact safety@swaply.app. For urgent situations, always contact your local emergency services first.
legal.dmcaSubtitle: Digital Millennium Copyright Act compliance and takedown procedures
legal.dmcaWhatIsText: The Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) is a United States copyright law that provides a process for copyright owners to request the removal of infringing content from online platforms. Swaply respects intellectual property rights and complies with the DMCA by promptly addressing valid takedown notices. This applies to all content uploaded to Swaply including item photos, descriptions, profile images, and any other user-generated content.
legal.dmcaReportingText: If you believe that content on Swaply infringes your copyright, you may submit a DMCA takedown notice. Copyright infringement on Swaply includes: using someone else's photographs without permission, copying product descriptions from other websites, uploading copyrighted logos or brand images you don't own, or using protected artwork or designs in listings. Use the form below to submit your report, or send an email to dmca@swaply.world.
legal.dmcaNoticeReqsText:
A valid DMCA takedown notice must contain:

1. Identification of the copyrighted work you claim has been infringed
2. Identification of the material on Swaply that you claim is infringing, with enough detail for us to locate it (URL)
3. Your contact information (name, address, phone number, email)
4. A statement that you have a good faith belief that use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner
5. A statement, under penalty of perjury, that the information in your notice is accurate and that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on behalf of the owner
6. Your physical or electronic signature
legal.dmcaCounterNoticeText: If you believe your content was removed by mistake or misidentification, you may file a counter-notice. Your counter-notice must include: identification of the removed material and its location before removal, a statement under penalty of perjury that you believe the material was removed by mistake, your name, address, phone number, and consent to jurisdiction. Upon receiving a valid counter-notice, we will forward it to the original complainant. If the complainant does not file a court action within 10-14 business days, the content may be restored.
legal.dmcaRepeatInfringerText: Swaply will terminate the accounts of users who are repeat copyright infringers. If a user receives three valid DMCA takedown notices, their account will be permanently suspended. We track all DMCA notices and maintain records for compliance purposes.
legal.dmcaContactText:
DMCA Agent: Swaply Legal Team
Email: dmca@swaply.world
Address: Jurilovca, Constanta, Romania

Please allow 2-3 business days for a response to your notice.

legal.copyrightSubtitle: Content ownership, intellectual property rights, and trademark policy
legal.copyrightOwnershipText: Users retain full ownership of the content they upload to Swaply, including photos, descriptions, and other materials. By uploading content to Swaply, you grant us a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to display, reproduce, and distribute your content solely for the purpose of operating and promoting the Swaply platform. This license ends when you delete your content or close your account.
legal.copyrightProhibitedText: Users must not upload content that infringes the intellectual property rights of others. This includes: photographs taken by others without permission, copyrighted product descriptions copied from other websites, third-party registered trademarks or logos, protected artwork, designs, or creative works used without authorization. Violations will result in content removal and may lead to account suspension.
legal.copyrightUserRespText: Users are solely responsible for ensuring they have the right to share any content they upload. You may list items you own and photograph them yourself. You may write original descriptions. You must not copy content from other platforms, use stock images you haven't licensed, or misrepresent the ownership of intellectual property. If in doubt about whether you can use certain content, err on the side of caution and create original materials.
legal.copyrightPlatformRightsText: The Swaply platform, including its name, logo, design, source code, algorithms, and all associated materials, is the intellectual property of Swaply and its creators. Users may not copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works based on Swaply's platform without express written permission. The Swaply brand, including the name and logo, are protected marks.
legal.copyrightTrademarkText: The Swaply name, logo, and associated branding are protected trademarks. Use of the Swaply trademark is only permitted in accordance with our brand guidelines. To report unauthorized use of the Swaply trademark, or if you believe your trademark is being misused on our platform, contact us at legal@swaply.world.
legal.termsIPText: Swaply respects intellectual property rights and expects users to do the same. Users must not upload content that infringes the copyrights or trademarks of others. Swaply complies with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) and will remove infringing content upon receiving valid takedown notices. For full details, see our DMCA Policy (/dmca) and Copyright Policy (/copyright). Repeat infringers will have their accounts terminated.

about.title: About Swaply
about.subtitle: A platform built on a simple idea: things don't die, they move on.
about.storyP1: I built Swaply because I had a drawer full of perfectly good things I no longer used — and I was tired of selling them for pennies or letting them collect dust.
about.storyP2: The idea is simple: if I have something you no longer need, and you have something I no longer need — why involve money?
about.storyP3: Swaply is where you swap directly, with no commissions, no price haggling, no PayPal, no bank transfers. Just two items and two people who need what the other has.
about.step1Title: Add what you want to give
about.step1Text: Photos, description, what you'd like in return.
about.step2Text: Browse or auto-match — the algorithm does the heavy lifting.
about.step3Text: Direct chat, agree on the details, and swap.
about.whyTitle: Why Swaply and not a classic marketplace?
about.whoQuote: Swaply is built by Petru Melinte from Jurilovca, Romania. We're not a corporation. We're a real project, built on the belief that the barter economy is more human than the consumer economy.
about.techDescription: Swaply is built with Next.js, React, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS. Hosted on Vercel, payments via Stripe. All code is written by a single developer — no team, no investors, just passion and coffee.
about.ctaSub: Free. No card required. No commissions.
about.metaDescription: The story behind Swaply — the platform for swapping objects without money.
